project.title: Biomass burning smoke as a driver of multi-scale microbial teleconnections
project.description: As part of the Biosmoke-Connect project, we characterized air, smoke, fuels, and soil samples collected during prescribed burning of tallgrass prairie at Konza Prairie Biological Station and subsequent experiments at University of Idaho iFire laboratory.
